content.short: We are making a free-to-play card game set in the fantasy world of Adania, where players will be able to earn and own the cards they play with.
content.description: Adventure through the lands of Adania, a distant realm of high fantasy. This is a land where humans, elves, orcs and goblins continually do battle for the sake of their own survival. We want to make a series of games that take place in the world of Adania and make use of the Cardano blockchain. We are committed to the promise that no Adania game will ever be pay-to-win. All of our games will be free-to-play, most of our games will have a play-&-earn aspect to them. The two parts you need to know about are: Adania Adventurers and Adania Cards. Adania Adventurers are the first release of NFTs that will be used in every game we make - they are the player's character! Adania Cards refers to the first game we want to make, a competitive dueling trading card game that uses NFTs in active gameplay. We will use the sale of Adania Adventurers to fund the development of the Adania Cards and following games.
